results.response: The NeuroFly 2026 conference will be held at the University of Cologne, Germany, from September 7th to 11th, 2026, as stated in the documentation from https://www.virtualflybrain.org/blog/2025/12/17/neurofly-2026-21st-biennial-european-drosophila-neurobiology-conference. VFB does not currently hold additional information on this conference beyond what is provided in the documentation.
